module_detail.name: Create a script for mapping and generate a json and csv file
Product display fetching for keeler brass kbc site

notes: Checked the suggested link by Jun on increasing the default Netlify deploy build time for the New KBC project. Based on my recent findings, the page type with a lot of queried paths is the product page which fetches ALL product IDs from Swell on build, not on demand (on page load) so the build time is expected to bloat on increased number of products paths (currently at 2.5k+). I have done a local development change to limit the returned paths to the latest 500 products on build while the rest would be loaded on demand. I will commit this change once we can verify it POST LIVE. On my local environment, I have also setup the Netlify CLI with confirmed login of the team Netlify account and run the commands from this reference: https://answers.netlify.com/t/support-guide-how-to-use-the-api-to-increase-your-sites-build-time-limit/52805?utm_content=ask-netlify. I then checked the Netlify deploys and waited for the latest one to finish after confirming the build time was set to 30mins (1800secs). The build was successful and it took a total of 21min 28secs.
